item.summary: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today addressed the NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi. Greeting the international delegates amidst the joyous festive season in the country, the Prime Minister welcomed the participants to the summit. He commended the gathering for deliberating on serious global matters.
item.title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi addresses the NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi
